ruleDefinitions.name: RDP Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of netsh to configure a port forwarding of port 3389 (RDP) rule

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ i.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ p.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\=3389.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ c.*")))
